Hawks 124Nets 121

Down 17, the Hawks steal it late

Final · Sat, Nov 7 · Atlanta

Down 17 early, Atlanta took its first lead with 1:26 left.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · How it went

Won the fourth quarter 36–26

Down 7 after three quarters, the Hawks won the fourth quarter 36–26 to win 124–121.

2 of 5 · Who carried it

Jalen Johnson: 30 points in his return

Back after missing three games. 11 of 17 from the floor.

3 of 5 · The Nets’ side

From the Nets’ side.

Led by 7 after three quarters, then lost the fourth 26–36.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it inside and off turnovers

Points in the paint 70–48; points off turnovers 28–13. Brooklyn turned it over 22 times.

5 of 5 · What it meant

Hawks 124, Nets 121.

The Hawks move to 7–5, 4th in the East. The Nets fall to 3–8, 13th in the East.
